questions.q: How much does a digital wedding invitation cost?
questions.a: Our prices start from €150 for the Basic package and go up to €350 for the Mini Website. Each package includes different features based on your needs.
Yes, all our packages include an RSVP form. The Premium and Mini Website packages offer advanced RSVP management with real-time notifications and guest list export.

questions.q: Can it be sent via Viber/WhatsApp?
questions.a: Absolutely! Each invitation has a unique link that you can easily share via Viber, WhatsApp, social media, or email with one click.

questions.q: Can it have a Google Maps?
questions.a: Yes, the Mini Website package includes an integrated Google Maps with the event location for your guests' convenience.

questions.q: Can it be in Greek and English?
questions.a: Yes, all invitations support multiple languages. You can have your invitation in Greek, English, or both simultaneously.
